Full design-to-launch build for a modern salon brand
A self-directed, full design-to-launch build — branding, color system, content, custom lookbook layout, and StyleSeat booking integration.

## The challenge
A self-directed project built to demonstrate a full design-to-launch workflow — starting from nothing and making every decision: brand, color, content, layout, and functionality.

## What we built
- Developed the full visual identity — color system, typography, and brand tone
- Selected and curated all imagery to match the brand aesthetic
- Built a custom lookbook-style layout for showcasing salon work
- Integrated StyleSeat for appointment booking
- Shipped a complete, production-ready site with no template starting point

## Outcome
A polished, fully functional salon website built entirely from scratch — demonstrating range across design, content, and development in a single project.

Ongoing web partnership for a growing therapy practice
Ongoing maintenance and content partnership for a small speech-language pathology practice expanding across multiple states.

## The challenge
Oceanview Therapy had an existing WordPress site that needed to grow alongside the practice — new content, new states, new capabilities — without losing what was already working.

## What we did
- Restructured navigation and reorganized site content for clarity
- Added and removed pages to reflect current services and focus
- Built a dynamic popup announcement for new licensing states
- Launched the Lighthouse Spotlight blog, including the first published post
- Updated FAQ and ongoing content as the practice evolves

## Outcome
Oceanview now has a web presence that keeps pace with a practice serving clients across 8 states and growing — with a content foundation that the team can build on over time.

New web presence for a growing speech therapy practice
A new website for a local speech-language pathology practice, built with a custom client intake form and Zanda Health booking integration.

## The challenge
Speech For Yourself needed a professional web presence that could do real work — not just look good, but actively help clients find the practice, understand what services are offered, and book an appointment without friction.

## What we built
- Designed and built a clean, accessible website from the ground up
- Built a custom client intake form for new patient inquiries
- Integrated Zanda Health for seamless appointment booking
- Optimized for accessibility, achieving a perfect 100 Lighthouse accessibility score

## Outcome
Speech For Yourself launched with a professional, fully functional web presence that works for both the practice and their clients — making it easy to connect, inquire, and book from any device.
